onboarding.description: Welcome and sign-up screens shown to brand-new users.

welcome.description: First screen new users see — a greeting, sign-up buttons and a short legal notice.

title.description: Big greeting at the top of the welcome screen.

legal_disclaimer.description: Small print with Terms and Privacy Policy links. In the app it sits just above the two buttons.

use_existing_account.description: Second button for people who already have an account.

privacy_policy_title.description: Title of the Privacy Policy page opened from the legal links.

terms_and_conditions_title.description: Title of the Terms & Conditions page opened from the legal links.

email_app_unavailable.description: Error shown only if the device has no email app to open.

link_open_failed.description: Error shown only if a link can’t be opened.

name.description: Asks the new user for their first name.

title.description: The question at the top of the screen.

placeholder.description: Grey hint text inside the name box.

continue.description: Button to move to the next step.

greeting.description: Short personal greeting shown after the name step.

message_prefix.description: Greeting text. The app adds the user’s name and a “!” straight after it — no name placeholder here.

user_type.description: Asks how much experience the user already has.

title.description: The question at the top (e.g. “Have you tried Sahaja Yoga before?”). Rich text so part of it can be bold.

option_tried_before.description: Second option — tried it once before.

get_started.description: Button at the bottom, shown after an option is chosen. (Appears last on screen.)

carousel.description: Three intro slides the user swipes through before signing up.

page_true_self_title.description: Slide 2 title. Rich text so “true self” can be emphasised.
page_true_self_title.section: Page 2 — Get to know your true self

page_true_self_subtitle.section: Page 2 — Get to know your true self

consent_modal.description: The marketing-consent screen. ⚠ This wording is saved into each user’s consent record for legal audit — editing it changes what’s recorded, not only what’s shown.

body_intro.description: Opening paragraph, with a link that shows exactly what is shared.

body_benefits.description: Paragraph on how sharing helps others find the app.

body_never_share.description: Paragraph listing the personal things that are never shared.

body_never_sell.description: Short line promising the app never sells user data.

body_settings_hint.description: Note that this choice can be changed later in settings.

consent_modal.title: Marketing consent

main.description: The Daily (home) tab — three full-height screens the user scrolls through.

start_meditation.description: Main button to begin the suggested meditation.

scroll_to_the_path.description: Scroll cue at the bottom of the first screen.

path_going_deeper_title.description: Title of the Path promo screen.

start_the_course.description: Button for someone who has not started the Path.

continue_the_course.description: Button for someone already past the first Path step.

shri_mataji_talks_title.description: FALLBACK — only when no card is set in App Cards. Normally the card’s own title is shown.

shri_mataji_talks_subtitle.description: FALLBACK — only when no card is set in App Cards. Normally the card’s own subtitle is shown.

see_more.description: FALLBACK button label. Normally the card’s own button text is shown.

start_now.description: FALLBACK button label on the first-meditation card. Normally the card’s own button text is shown.

hero_label_learn_from_source.description: FALLBACK small label above the card. Normally the card’s own section label is shown.

hero_label_get_started.description: FALLBACK small label, before the first meditation.

hero_label_try_something_new.description: FALLBACK small label when the card is a meditation.

hero_label_meditate_with_others.description: FALLBACK small label when the card points at classes.

hero_label_discover.description: FALLBACK small label for any other card.

help_me_deal_custom_title.description: Title of the screen opened by the third tile.

meditate_with_others.description: Heading above the two class tiles.

improve_card_techniques_title.description: FALLBACK — only when no highlight cards are set in App Cards.

improve_card_techniques_subtitle.description: FALLBACK — only when no highlight cards are set in App Cards.

improve_card_subtle_system_title.description: FALLBACK — only when no highlight cards are set in App Cards.

improve_card_subtle_system_subtitle.description: FALLBACK — only when no highlight cards are set in App Cards.

minutes_short.description: Short duration suffix on cards, e.g. the “min” in “12 min”.

live_now.description: Badge on a card while a live class is running.

live_countdown_days.description: Countdown on a card, days before a live class.

live_countdown_hours.description: Countdown on a card, hours before a live class.

live_countdown_minutes.description: Countdown on a card, minutes before a live class.

start_course.description: NOT DISPLAYED. Matched against a card’s button text to detect the “start course” action — changing it can stop that matching working.

continue_course.description: NOT DISPLAYED. Matched against a card’s button text to detect the “continue course” action.

common.description: Shared error and "coming soon" messages that pop up across the Home and Profile area — not a screen of its own.

something_went_wrong.description: Generic error message. Shown as the heading of the error screen (with a Retry button below it) and as the text of several error pop-ups when content fails to load or an action can't be completed.

retry.description: Label on the Retry button below the error message; tapping it reloads the content after a failure.

card_action_not_available.description: Pop-up message shown only when a tapped card can't be opened because its destination is missing, unknown, or invalid.

external_link_coming_soon.description: Pop-up message shown only when a tapped card's external link is missing or can't be opened.

music_coming_soon.description: Pop-up message shown only when someone taps a Music or album card (or a music item in profile activity), which isn't available yet.

common.title: Errors & coming-soon messages

load_info.description: Messages for when the Daily screen has trouble loading its meditations. Two show as a brief pop-up at the bottom of the screen when a random meditation is substituted; the other four are prepared in code but are not shown anywhere in the current app.

top_daily_unavailable.description: Prepared for when the daily meditation has no content and no replacement can be found. Not currently shown anywhere in the app.

top_daily_failed.description: Prepared for when loading the daily meditation errors out and no replacement can be found. Not currently shown anywhere in the app.

top_daily_random.description: Brief pop-up at the bottom of the Daily screen, shown when the daily meditation could not be loaded and a random meditation is shown in its place.

quick_daily_unavailable.description: Prepared for when the quick meditations have no content and no replacements can be found. Not currently shown anywhere in the app.

quick_daily_failed.description: Prepared for when loading the quick meditations errors out and no replacements can be found. Not currently shown anywhere in the app.

quick_daily_random.description: Brief pop-up at the bottom of the Daily screen, shown when the quick meditations could not be loaded and random meditations are shown in their place.

load_info.title: Daily — Load Messages

path.description: The Path tab, a step-by-step guided course. A Path step is one lesson in that list; the sections below are the stages inside a single step.

overview.description: The Path tab's main list: the label above each group of steps, the message at the bottom of the list, and the error state.

unit.description: Label above each group of steps on the Path list. The unit number is added after it automatically, so it reads like "UNIT 1".

more_steps_coming_soon.description: Message at the very bottom of the Path list, below the last step.

error_message.description: Only shown when the Path fails to load — the message in the middle of the screen. The same message is also used when a step's article fails to load.

retry.description: Only shown with that error message — the button that tries loading again.

info.description: Three full-screen intro slides about the Path, shown the first time the Path opens and from the info button on the Path screen. The user taps or swipes from one slide to the next.

first_text.description: Paragraph under that heading on the first slide.

second_text.description: Paragraph on the second slide. It contains a bulleted list — keep the line-break markers and the bullet characters exactly as they appear in the English text.

third_title.description: Heading on the third and last slide.

third_text.description: Paragraph on the last slide. Keep the line-break markers exactly as they appear in the English text.

step_1.description: The opening section of a Path step: the step title, a photo, a quote with a credit under it, and the Begin button.
step_1.title: Intro

author.description: The credit line printed under the quote. It is the same for every step — it always reads "Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi", even when the quote shown above it was written for that step by someone else. There is no per-step way to change this credit.

begin.description: Button at the bottom that starts the step.

skip_title.description: Question shown when the user taps the back arrow on this section and is asked whether to leave the step.

skip_continue.description: Not shown anywhere. The prompt for leaving the step uses the Meditation section's buttons instead (Exit / Back to step).
skip_continue.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

back_to_path.description: Not shown anywhere. The prompt for leaving the step uses the Meditation section's "Back to step" button instead.
back_to_path.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

step_2.description: The swipeable full-screen story panels of a Path step.
step_2.title: Story

continue_button.description: Button that appears only on the last story panel and moves on to the meditation. The same wording is also used on the last of the three Path intro slides.

step_3.description: The spoken introduction that plays before the meditation, plus the prompts for skipping the introduction or leaving the step.
step_3.title: Meditation

meditation_intro.description: Heading at the top of the screen while the spoken introduction is playing.

skip_intro.description: Text button at the bottom of that screen, offering to go straight to the meditation.

skip_title.description: Question shown after tapping that button, asking whether to skip the introduction.

skip_continue.description: Button on that question that goes straight to the meditation.

back_to_intro.description: Button on that question that keeps listening to the introduction.

exit.description: Button that leaves the step. It appears on the prompt shown when the user taps the back arrow on the Intro section.

back_to_step.description: Button on that same prompt that stays in the step.

start_meditation.description: Not shown anywhere. The spoken introduction runs into the meditation on its own, so there is no Start Meditation button on this screen.
start_meditation.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

step_4.description: The in-depth article at the end of a Path step. The article's own headings and text come from the article content, not from here — this leaf covers the talk card inside it and the button that finishes the step.
step_4.title: Article

media_card_fallback_title.description: FALLBACK — the title on the talk card, shown only when the talk itself has no title; normally the talk's own title is shown. This card appears wherever a talk is placed in content, not only in this Path article.

media_card_author.description: The name shown under the talk card. It is the same for every talk card in the app — the speaker recorded with the talk is not used. Appears wherever a talk card is shown, not only in this Path article.

media_card_author_subtitle.description: The smaller line under that name on the talk card. Also the same for every talk card in the app.

media_card_watch_later.description: Button on the talk card that saves the talk to watch later. Appears wherever a talk card is shown.

complete_step.description: Button at the end of the article that marks the step as completed.

delving_deeper.description: NOT DISPLAYED — an old heading for the article section. The article now supplies its own headings, so nothing shows this text.
delving_deeper.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

lecture_prompt.description: NOT DISPLAYED — an old line introducing the talk before playing it. Nothing shows this text today.
lecture_prompt.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

step_complete.description: The screen shown after finishing a Path step.
step_complete.title: Completed

title.description: The large text in the middle of the completion screen.

subtitle.description: The smaller line under that text.

back_to_path.description: Not shown anywhere. The button on this screen reads "Continue", and that wording is not editable in the CMS.
back_to_path.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

explore.description: The Explore tab for browsing meditations, talks, and classes.

overview.description: The Explore tab: three stacked sections (Meditate, Learn, Join free classes). Each section shows a small shared label above a big heading, then a grid of tappable cards. Some Meditate cards are locked and show a "Coming soon" label.

section_label.description: Small label shown above every section heading on the Explore tab. The same word appears above all three sections (Meditate, Learn and Join free classes).

section_meditate_title.description: Heading of the first Explore section, which holds the meditation cards.

card_daily_title.description: Title of the Daily card, the first card in the Meditate section.

card_daily_subtitle.description: One-line description shown under the Daily card title.

card_path_title.description: Title of the Path card in the Meditate section.

card_path_subtitle.description: One-line description shown under the Path card title.

card_techniques_title.description: Title of the Techniques card in the Meditate section.

card_techniques_subtitle.description: One-line description shown under the Techniques card title.

card_vibes_check_title.description: Title of the Vibes check card. This card is coming-soon (locked) and shows the "Coming soon" label instead of a subtitle.

card_vibes_check_subtitle.description: NOT DISPLAYED — the Vibes check card is coming-soon, so its subtitle slot always shows the "Coming soon" label instead of this text. The value is passed to the card but never appears on screen.

card_music_title.description: Title of the Music for meditation card. This card is coming-soon (locked); it shows the "Coming soon" label where a subtitle would go.

card_challenges_title.description: Title of the Challenges card. This card is coming-soon (locked); it shows the "Coming soon" label where a subtitle would go.

section_learn_title.description: Heading of the second Explore section, which holds the learning cards.

card_who_is_title.description: Title of the "Who is Shri Mataji" card, the first card in the Learn section. Keep the line break between the two lines.

card_talks_title.description: Title of the "Lectures of Shri Mataji" card in the Learn section. Keep the line break between the two lines.

card_subtle_system_title.description: Title of the Subtle System card in the Learn section.

card_what_is_title.description: Title of the "What is Sahaja Yoga?" card, the last card in the Learn section.

section_join_title.description: Heading of the third Explore section, for joining free classes.

card_live_online_title.description: Title of the Live Online Classes card in the Join free classes section. Keep the line break between the two lines.

card_find_classes_title.description: Title of the "Find classes near you" card in the Join free classes section. Keep the line break between the two lines.

card_coming_soon.description: The "Coming soon" label shown in place of the subtitle on locked cards (Vibes check, Music and Challenges).

subtle_system.description: The Subtle System screen — a tall body diagram you tap to explore the chakras and energy channels, plus the pop-up that opens when a point on the diagram is tapped.

screen_label.description: Small heading in the bar at the very top of the screen. Shown in capital letters.

diagram_title.description: Big heading above the body diagram. When the same diagram appears in the summary after a meditation, a heading set on that meditation in the CMS replaces this one.

diagram_subtitle.description: Short line under the big heading, telling people they can tap the points on the diagram. Leave it empty to hide the line.

mode_chakras.description: Label of the left button under the diagram, which switches the diagram to show the chakras.

mode_channels.description: Label of the right button under the diagram, which switches the diagram to show the energy channels.

front_view_mirrored.description: Small grey note in the top-left corner of the pop-up, explaining that the body is seen from the front so left and right look swapped.
front_view_mirrored.section: Pop-up when a point is tapped

chip_right.description: First of the three side buttons at the bottom of the pop-up, for showing the right side.
chip_right.section: Pop-up when a point is tapped

chip_center.description: Second of the three side buttons at the bottom of the pop-up, for showing the centre.
chip_center.section: Pop-up when a point is tapped

chip_left.description: Third of the three side buttons at the bottom of the pop-up, for showing the left side.
chip_left.section: Pop-up when a point is tapped

aspect_right.description: Not shown anywhere in the app right now. The pop-up uses the shorter "Right" button label instead.

talks_intro.description: The screen that introduces Shri Mataji's talks before a video plays. It comes in two looks: the ordinary intro (used from Explore, from the daily meditation, and when opening one specific clip), and a separate portrait version shown once, right after someone finishes their first meditation.

title.description: Heading at the top of the intro, naming the talks. Shown on every version except the one after the first meditation.

clip_description.description: Short line under the heading. Only shown when the intro is for one particular video clip, including when it is opened from the daily meditation.

generic_description.description: The long paragraph about Shri Mataji, below her photo. Not shown on the short single-clip version of the intro.

watch_now.description: Label of the button at the bottom that opens the video. The running time is added in brackets after it automatically. Shown on every version except the one after the first meditation.

post_first_meditation_name.description: Name shown just under the portrait, on the special version of this screen that appears once someone has finished their first meditation.

post_first_meditation_subtitle.description: Small italic line under the name on that same after-the-first-meditation screen.
post_first_meditation_subtitle.section: Shown right after the first meditation

post_first_meditation_description.description: The sentence in the middle of that screen, inviting the person to watch the talk.

start.description: Label of the main button on that screen. The running time is added in brackets after it automatically. Only used there — every other version of the intro uses the "Watch now" label instead.
start.section: Shown right after the first meditation

maybe_later.description: Label of the quieter second button under the main one, for skipping the video. Only on the after-the-first-meditation screen.
maybe_later.section: Shown right after the first meditation

unavailable.description: Brief message that slides up from the bottom of the screen only when a talk cannot be opened.

talks_list.description: The list of Shri Mataji's talks — a large featured talk at the top, then a short intro block, then the rows of remaining talks.

screen_title.description: Small heading in the bar at the very top of the screen. Shown in capital letters.

section_title.description: FALLBACK — heading of the intro block below the featured talk; normally the heading entered on the talks page in the CMS is shown.

subtitles_title.description: Heading at the top of the subtitles menu that slides up from the bottom of the player.

subtitles_off.description: First option in the subtitles menu, for turning subtitles off. Always listed.

subtitles_english.description: Names a language as it appears in the subtitles menu. Only listed when the talk actually has subtitles in that language.

profile.description: The Profile tab, with account, history, favourites, and settings.

main.description: The landing screen of the Profile tab: the member's name and how long they have been a member, a strip of their favourite meditations, then the menu rows for History, Account settings, Contact us and the legal pages.

joined_fallback.description: Shown when we do not know when the person joined, or when they joined less than a month ago.

joined_one_month.description: Shown when the person joined exactly one month ago.

joined_months.description: Shown when the person joined between two and eleven months ago. Keep the {months} placeholder — the number is filled in.

joined_one_year.description: Shown for the whole first year of membership, from one year up to just under two years.

joined_years.description: Shown from two years of membership onwards. Keep the {years} placeholder — the number of full years is filled in.

favourites_header.description: Small heading above the row of favourite meditations.

see_all.description: Link on the right of that heading that opens the full Favourites list. Always visible, even when there are no favourites.

no_favourites_title.description: Title of the placeholder card shown in place of the favourites row when the person has not saved anything yet. The same text is also used on the full Favourites screen when it is empty.

no_favourites_subtitle.description: Explaining line under that placeholder title. Also reused on the empty Favourites screen.

history_title.description: Title of the first menu row, which opens the History screen.

history_subtitle.description: Smaller line under the History row title.

account_title.description: Title of the second menu row, which opens Account settings.

account_subtitle.description: Smaller line under the Account settings row title.

feedback_header.description: Small heading that introduces the Contact us row.

contact_title.description: Title of the Contact us row, which opens the feedback form.

contact_subtitle.description: Smaller line under the Contact us row title.

legal_header.description: Small heading above the last group of rows at the bottom of the screen.

privacy_policy_title.description: Title of the row that opens the Privacy Policy.

privacy_policy_subtitle.description: Smaller line under the Privacy Policy row title.

terms_and_conditions_title.description: Title of the row that opens the Terms & Conditions.

favourites.description: The full list of meditations and talks the member has saved, opened from 'See All' on the Profile screen.

title.description: Heading at the top of the Favourites screen.

removed_from_favourites.description: Brief message that pops up at the bottom after the member unlikes an item; it comes with an Undo button.

history.description: The list of the member's past meditations and other activity, opened from the History row on the Profile screen.

empty_title.description: Title of the placeholder card shown when the member has no activity yet.

account.description: The "My Account" screen reached from Profile, plus all its pop-ups: editing the name and email, sending a password reset link, and deleting the account.

title.description: Big heading at the top of the screen.

first_name_label.description: Small grey label above the person's first name, in the first row of the list.

email_label.description: Small grey label above the email address row. Only shown once someone is signed in.

password_label.description: Small grey label above the password row. Only shown for people who signed in with an email and password, not with Google, Apple or Facebook.

edit_action.description: Small link on the right-hand side of every row that can be changed. The same word is used on all of them.

email_unavailable.description: FALLBACK — shown in the email row only when the account has no email address on record; normally the person's real email address is shown.

logout.description: Main button at the bottom of the screen, shown when someone is signed in.

delete_account.description: Second button at the bottom, shown when someone is signed in. The same words are reused as the heading and as the red confirm button on the delete-account screen.

create_account.description: Main button at the bottom, shown instead of the log-out button when nobody is signed in.

login.description: Second button at the bottom, shown instead of the delete button when nobody is signed in.

edit_first_name_title.description: Heading of the pop-up that slides up from the bottom when the edit link next to the first name is tapped.

edit_email_title.description: Heading of the pop-up that slides up when the edit link next to the email address is tapped.

cancel.description: Second button that closes a pop-up without changing anything. Shared by the edit pop-ups, the reset-password pop-up and the confirm-password pop-up.

continue_action.description: Main button in that pop-up, tapped after typing the password.

save_failed.description: Error shown as a small bar at the bottom, only when a new first name could not be saved.

email_edit_unavailable.description: Message shown as a small bar at the bottom every time someone tries to save a new email address. Changing the email is not built yet, so this always appears.

delete_account_error.description: Error shown only when deleting the account fails for an unexpected reason.

delete_account_requires_recent_login.description: Error shown only when deleting fails because the person has not signed in recently enough.

error_invalid_credentials.description: Error shown when the email or password is wrong. English: "Incorrect email or password".

error_too_many_requests.description: Error shown only after too many failed sign-in attempts. English: "Too many attempts. Please try again later".

error_session_persistence.description: Error shown only when sign-in succeeds but the session couldn't be saved. English: "Signed in, but failed to restore your session".

error_generic.description: Fallback error shown when sign-in fails for any other reason. English: "Failed to sign in".

restore_password.description: Forgot/restore-password screen: the user enters their email to receive a password-reset link.

title.description: Header at the top of the restore-password screen.

description.description: Short intro line under the header telling the user to enter their email so a reset link can be sent.

email_label.description: Label above the email input box.

email_placeholder.description: Greyed-out hint text inside the empty email input box.

submit.description: Main button that sends the password-reset request.

error_invalid_email.description: Error shown under the email field only when the entered email is empty or not a valid address.

restore_password_email_sent.description: Confirmation screen shown after the password-reset email has been sent: a centered message with an email icon, and an OK button.

message.description: Centered confirmation text shown after the reset email is sent, telling the user an email has been sent and to check their inbox. Contains a line break that should be kept.

ok.description: Label of the button at the bottom that dismisses the confirmation and returns the user to the sign-in flow.

create_account.description: Create-account flow: the sign-up landing/method-chooser screen (heading, consent, skip) and the email sign-up form (fields, buttons, errors) reached by tapping "Continue with Email".

screen_title.description: Main heading on the sign-up landing screen — the default wording, "Let's now create your account!" (gate and onboarding-start entry points use other keys not in this leaf).

screen_subtitle.description: Sub-heading under the main heading, explaining that creating an account saves progress and unlocks features.

error_check_consent.description: Error shown only when the user taps a sign-up option without first ticking the consent checkbox.

skip_and_explore.description: Bottom button on the sign-up landing screen that skips account creation and continues into the app (default wording).

title.description: Top-bar title on the email sign-up form (the screen reached by tapping "Continue with Email").

email_label.description: Label above the email field on the email sign-up form.

email_placeholder.description: Grey hint text inside the empty email field.

password_label.description: Label above the password field on the email sign-up form.

password_placeholder.description: Grey hint text inside the empty password field.

submit.description: Main button on the email sign-up form that creates the account.

creating.description: Replaces the submit button label while the account is being created.

error_invalid_email.description: Error under the email field, only if the server rejects the address as invalid; the form's own live check normally catches a bad email first.

error_weak_password.description: Error under the password field, only if the server rejects the password as too weak; the form already requires 6+ characters (with a number) before you can submit.

error_too_many_requests.description: Error shown only after too many failed sign-up attempts in a short time.

error_session_persistence.description: Error shown only when the account was created but the app couldn't restore the login session.

error_generic.description: FALLBACK — shown when sign-up fails for a reason not covered by the more specific messages above; normally one of those is shown.

error_email_in_use.description: Appears unused — email collisions show the “You already have an account” sheet instead. Kept pending a product decision.
error_email_in_use.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

login_with_existing_account.description: Appears unused — its button is gated by a flag that is never turned on, so it can’t currently show. Kept pending a product decision.
login_with_existing_account.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

error_google_failed.description: Appears unused — a failed Google sign-in shows a shared error dialog instead. Kept pending a product decision.
error_google_failed.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

error_apple_failed.description: Appears unused — a failed Apple sign-in shows a shared error dialog instead. Kept pending a product decision.
error_apple_failed.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

error_facebook_failed.description: Appears unused — a failed Facebook sign-in shows a shared error dialog instead. Kept pending a product decision.
error_facebook_failed.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

error_provider_cancelled.description: Appears unused — a cancelled social sign-in is dismissed silently with no message. Kept pending a product decision.
error_provider_cancelled.section: Currently unused — needs a product decision

consent_label.description: The "I agree to WeMeditate's Terms & Conditions … Privacy Policy" line, with tappable links, next to the consent checkbox on the sign-up landing screen. Keep both link phrases intact.

navigation.description: The four labels on the bottom navigation bar, shown on every main screen (left to right: Daily, Path, Explore, Profile). If any label is missing a translation, the app silently falls back to the English word.

daily.description: First tab label on the bottom bar. English: "Daily".

path.description: Second tab label on the bottom bar. English: "Path".

explore.description: Third tab label on the bottom bar. English: "Explore".

profile.description: Fourth tab label on the bottom bar. English: "Profile".

general.description: Generic button/action labels reused across the app, mostly on error and confirmation screens.

back.description: "Back" button shown on the meditation player's error screen (when a meditation fails to load), next to Retry, to return to the previous screen.

retry.description: "Retry" button shown on failed/unavailable screens (meditation player and talk player load failures, and the profile screen's load error) to try loading again.

undo.description: "Undo" action shown briefly in a message after removing a favourite, letting the user restore it.
